correctness.rationale: The Petersen graph is KG(5,2), so its automorphism group S5 acts on ten vertices; target color S4 acts on product-of-simplex Hom(P,K4). Every cell is a ten-tuple of nonempty color sets with disjointness at graph edges. The source standalone verifier recursively enumerates 12960 proper colorings, then expands allowed color sets to the entire 221520-cell polyhedral Hom complex with dimension vector (12960,53280,80400,54960,17400,2400,120); a one-color-recoloring BFS proves connectedness. An element (sigma,tau) acts on each fixed source-coordinate cycle of length ell by Koszul permutations of simplex factors and internal color permutation; after Euler sign the contribution is (-1)^(|A|-1)sgn(tau^ell|A). Inspecting the exact exhaustive 35-class trace algorithm and independently reprojecting its published 7x5 integer trace table against class sizes and S5 Specht character chi_(3,2)=C(f,2)+t-f yields +1 on S^(3,2) box trivial and -1 on its conjugate S^(2,2,1) box sign4. Rational semisimplicity and Hopf trace imply occurrence in at least one positive even and one positive odd degree, respectively. This virtual result deliberately does not identify individual graded Betti numbers or integral torsion.
